TEXT: On the day of Comiket.
Kirino and I met up with Kuroneko and Saori before going into the convention hall.
I basically spent the whole morning trying to stop Kirino and Kuroneko from quarreling and being struck by Kirino after discovering a bespectacled
maid's doujinshi, but well, it was fun, I guess.
And in the afternoon, we were supposed to meet in front of the stand to take part in the special event that Saori recommended.
...is how it should have been, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Geez, where did the two of them go?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now now, restrain thyself, Kyousuke-shi. The two of them probably had goods they each wanted to buy this afternoon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But, leaving Kuroneko aside, Kirino has just recovered her memories, so what should we do if she hits her head again in a place like this?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hahaha, Kyousuke-shi really does care for his little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, do you have any idea the trouble I went through during this whole incident? If I were to go through it again, I'd probably die of exhaustion.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: There's no need to worry, getting hit on the head won't result in memory loss like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I asked an acquaintance in a hospital about it, and I learned that most causes of memory loss are either external or emotional injuries.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: For Kiririn-shi's case, the actual cause was probably due to stress.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Stress... Huh. That's a concept completely foreign to her.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: With all due respect, I do have an idea of what the cause of Kiririn-shi's stress might be.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What, tell me without giving off such an air of importance about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Huhu, Kiririn-shi's probably starved for love.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What was that? That word, which suits Kirino the least out of all the words in the entire world?
Love, love for who? Love for 2D little sisters?
Ahh... My head hurts just by thinking about these strange things...
Damn, that Saori... Making a :3 face again... She's definitely enjoying this!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Well then, the event is about to start, so let's go.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? H-Hold on. Shouldn't we wait for Kirino and Kuroneko?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: The two of them already went there ahead of us. Come, let's join them at the cosplay area!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey! Don't push me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Woah! What's with this enthusiasm?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Doesn't it look like everyone that attended Comiket today is gathered here? Say, Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...She's not here?!
Crap... Did we get separated in the crowd?
... There's too many people, it seems that it will be very difficult to find her.
Oh well, they're somewhere in this hall anyway. It feels lonely, but I'll just watch by myself.
...But anyway, it's a really grand event.
The set is excessively extravagant... The specially-installed stage even has girls that looks like idols on it.
Furthermore, those girls look really high level. Could they be really popular idols?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Now that I think about it, I feel like I've seen them before...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh... Eeeeeeeeh!
Why are Kirino and Kuroneko both on this stage while surrounded by cheers, moreover when did Saori even get up there too!

SPEAKER: SPK_ANNOUNCER
TEXT: Everyone, thank you for waiting. The theme song unveiling event is about to start.

SPEAKER: SPK_ANNOUNCER
TEXT: The opening speech will be by Kiririn-san, who provided the theme song for this summer's Comic Circle Market!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Hello everyone, I'm Kiririn.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Thank you for letting me attend the unveiling event for this year. Umm... T-This... This...song...
Hey, hey, is she all right? She looks like she's struggling quite a bit, which is unusual for her.
Hmm? Seems like there are some whispers coming through the speakers...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph, getting all nervous over such a trivial thing. This is why commoners are nothing but headaches.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: S-Shut up! I have a sense of shame, unlike you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That's right, Kuroneko-shi. Anyone would also be nervous confessing to the guy they like.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: This and that are two completely different things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh my? I was certain you were here for a confession to a big brother...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Huh? Who would confess to that guy...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That guy? Although I said a big brother, I didn't say it was YOUR big brother.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: W-W-Wha...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now, now... both of you, please stop here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Tch.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph...
Hey, you guys, we can perfectly hear everything you're saying...
And Kuroneko, stop dragging me out as an example...
Oh! But it looks like Kirino's nervousness has calmed down now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: T-This song was created for the sake of an Onii-chan present here.
Heh, as expected from my little sister... Even that opening speech was well said...
However, it seems that she's glancing over in my direction a little...
Well, it's probably my imagination.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: For the one and only irreplaceable Onii-chan...
...What?
An irreplaceable Onii-chan?  Kirino has another older brother?!
Wait, that's impossible...
...So then, those words just now... Could it be...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...I shall now start singing. Please listen carefully... Aniki①
As soon as the song started, the atmosphere around the stage reached its peak.
In the middle of the hall as a strange excitement and enthusiasm whirled around me, I managed to see it through the crowd of otaku.
The brilliant smile my sister gave as she winked at me, a smile that felt as if she was putting her entire being from this life... no, from even her previous life
and the next one into it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Good work. You did unexpectedly well there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: T-That's obvious. I'm the one who was singing after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, yeah. You're right. Ah, by the way...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: In the end, Kirino, why did you lose your memories?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Eh? Why are you asking about that now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No reason really, I just suddenly thought of it. So, what was the reason?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I-I remember at that time... I was chatting with the other two and then I suddenly got excited!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hmm, what was it about? ......Ah!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I probably got too excited and slipped from the stairs while going to get some fruit juice, yeah!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Just what got you so excited that you fell from the stairs?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: T-That was... umm, that's right! I got all excited discussing about a new game～! Ah-ahahaha!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You really are hopeless...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Hmph. Were we really discussing that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Ahh, so it's about that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? What are you talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...! You two, stop right now! Don't say anything unnecessary!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: At that time... you were gleefully babbling about Senpai coming home the next day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Wha-! I-I never said such things!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh really. Then was the way you merrily talked about looking forward to the souvenir from his trip a hallucination?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Guhhhh!! What's with you?! I already said I never said such things!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ouch?! Why did you kick me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Shut up!! I haven't gotten back that part of my memory, so I don't know anything!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I don't know-!!!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Anything at all, okay!!!!!
...I understand right now. What I feared most about Kirino losing her memories.
It was the fear that our sibling relationship would return to what it was before.
I didn't want her to lose only the memories of this past year where our sibling relationship got sliiightly better.
Looking at Kirino smiling with her friends, her face flushed red for some reason, with her memories recovered...
...Suddenly, this came to mind:
【My Little Sister Can't Be This Cute.】
